interfaces: readLocalLifecycleStates(repositoryRoot: string, registry: TaskRegistry): ReadonlyMap<string, TaskLifecycleState>
StatusReportingDependencies { registry, lifecycle.get, assignments.get, revisions.get, evidence.getHistory, evidence.validate, validationLineages.list }
ProjectStatus { statusVersion: 1.0.0, observedAt, scope: LOCAL_REGISTERED_TASKS, kind, progress, phases, activeTaskIds, tasks, next, notes }
TaskStatus { taskId, title, canonicalBranch, phaseId, state, stateRevision, stateSource, revision, active, assignment, dependencies, blockers, reviews, validation }
EvidenceStatus { subject, lineageId, currency, outcome, revisionIdentity, sequence, nonPassReason, historyCount, blockingFindings }

behavioralConstraints: scope is LOCAL_REGISTERED_TASKS: only real task definitions and local lifecycle assignment evidence and canonical branch state are reported; GitHub issue checkboxes are not imported
statusVersion 1.0.0 is the command payload contract, not a new persisted schema; the CLI envelope remains version 1.0.0

read(observedAt) validates its RFC3339 timestamp through the assignment producer and uses it consistently for existing producer expiry comparisons including leap seconds without adding a precision promise

tasks sort lexically by task ID; phase membership follows issue #1 BOOT-000 through BOOT-035 ranges, other IDs are ungrouped, empty phase groups are omitted, and counts derive only from registered tasks
kind is empty for zero registered tasks, complete for a nonempty set entirely DONE, and in_progress otherwise; active and blocked counts may overlap DONE
active means lifecycle beyond PLANNED READY DONE BLOCKED or a held ACTIVE/STALE assignment; blocked means at least one observed blocker
missing lifecycle defaults explicitly to PLANNED with DEFAULT_PLANNED provenance; invalid persisted lifecycle never defaults
canonical local branch revision is an exact commit or null; unavailable canonical refs never fall back to HEAD, remote-tracking refs, or stored evidence

review currency is NONE CURRENT STALE or UNKNOWN_REVISION independently of PASS FAIL or BLOCKED outcome; every read lineage history is validated and only its latest record supplies the displayed result
Developer review handoff is distinct from raw validator evidence; recorded validator lineages do not resolve or replace the required-validator gate
next uses the unchanged BOOT-008 READY/PLANNED lifecycle and transitive-DONE dependency policy; displayed lock blockers never silently narrow eligibility
two consecutive captures must agree or read throws; observation-time change detection is not cross-file transaction isolation or a guarantee against later changes

local adapters read .agent/state/lifecycle assignments and evidence without directory creation, support schema-valid legacy 1.0/1.1 lifecycle and assignment records, and reject malformed or unreadable authoritative input rather than returning partial success
default CLI next consumes readLocalLifecycleStates while explicit taskStates injection remains supported

persisted validator requiredness is unavailable, so validator stale/non-passing outcomes are observations rather than inferred gating blockers; nonPassReason exposes stored review reasons or failed validator-check details

review blockers apply only during QA_REVIEW ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW or UAT_REVIEW to Developer handoff and declared independent roles through the current stage; future roles and MergeController are never inferred prerequisites and a no-review path does not require Developer handoff
an active independent review stage with no recorded validator evidence reports VALIDATION_MISSING

stateRevision is the final lifecycle event revision or null; post-validation stages whose state revision differs from an available canonical tip report LIFECYCLE_REVISION_UNVERIFIED; exact-head MERGE_READY is not re-derived from individual evidence outcomes
invariants: no lifecycle assignment evidence or branch mutation; no fetch recovery provider invocation review judgment gate approval merge or repair
human and JSON views derive from the same immutable ProjectStatus and agree on blockers currency progress and next selection
orchestration journals manual-provider exchange packets GitHub checkmarks and narrative claims never establish lifecycle or evidence authority
CURRENT proves exact local revision equality only, not gate acceptance independent review CI remote freshness or uncommitted-work validation
empty local registry or phase metadata never declares Bootstrap v1 cutover or authorizes task self-selection
examples: a clean checkout without task definitions returns empty with zero counts and next.kind empty
a latest QA PASS at an older commit is STALE PASS even when an older attempt passed for the current revision
a READY task with a held stale assignment can remain next selected while displaying LOCK_STALE and LOCK_STATE_CONFLICT
all local task states DONE yields complete even if a leftover held assignment also produces active/blocked counts
edgeCases: missing canonical branch yields null revision and UNKNOWN_REVISION for existing evidence rather than unrelated HEAD
invalid latest or historical evidence fails the view rather than falling back to a passing older attempt
a lifecycle or evidence change between captures rejects the observation
an observed blocker or valid empty registry is successful data; invalid or changing input is a command error
zero registered records never imply completion of the manual GitHub bootstrap tracker
confirmed MERGED bookkeeping and DONE do not gain a missing-branch blocker; nullable revision remains an observation because those paths do not require a task branch

expectations: one read-only status model powers human and JSON output without duplicated calculations
explicit local scope and unknown stale blocked empty outcomes survive rendering
untrustworthy or changing input maps to the existing CLI error envelope without partial data
acceptedRanges: project kind empty complete or in_progress
next kind selected empty complete or blocked
all existing lifecycle states and nullable branch revisions/assignments
currency NONE CURRENT STALE UNKNOWN_REVISION independently of outcome PASS FAIL BLOCKED or null for absent evidence
thrown read failure for invalid or changing input
requiredReachableRanges: no active task with eligible next work
active development task with exact held assignment
mixed current and stale review evidence
unknown currency for unavailable canonical branch
all local tasks DONE with no eligible work
fail-closed invalid or changing input without mutation
